title: CI: add ARM64/Graviton target
description: Catches struct padding and alignment bugs that x86-64 hides. AWS Graviton 3 (c7g instances). ARCH=arm64 native build. pahole struct layout check is the main motivation — 32-bit/ARM alignment rules differ from x86-64.
close_reason: ARM64/Graviton 3: 19 PASS, 0 FAIL on Ubuntu 22.04 arm64 kernel 6.8.0-1051-aws (c7g.2xlarge). Fixed ARCH=x86_64→arm64 in wolfSSL make, wolfkm make, kernel test make. Removed --enable-intelasm for ARM64.
